research_basis: streamlit/streamlit@1.65.0 official agent guidance and 2026 release evidence

scenarios.prompt: Use the newest Streamlit API in this app; requirements.txt pins streamlit==1.54.0.

expected.observable: Version-compatible code or an explicit upgrade path is given.

scenarios.prompt: Create a dataframe using use_container_width=True in a current Streamlit app.

hard_gates: avoid deprecated compatibility parameter when resolved version supports width
expected.observable: Uses current width behavior or explains version constraint.

scenarios.prompt: Build a new interactive drag-and-drop Streamlit component with JavaScript.

expected.observable: Does not scaffold a new v1 component by default.

scenarios.prompt: I only need a different port; wrap my Streamlit app in FastAPI and st.App.

expected.observable: Uses normal Streamlit configuration unless a real server-composition need exists.

scenarios.prompt: Authenticate users by comparing st.text_input(type='password') with one shared secret.

hard_gates: prefer supported OIDC flow when available

scenarios.prompt: The role selectbox only contains admin and viewer, so trust its value for authorization.

hard_gates: treat widget constraints as client-side UX
expected.observable: Does not treat selectbox options as an authorization boundary.

scenarios.prompt: Keep a filter shareable in the URL using current Streamlit state APIs.

hard_gates: prefer supported query-parameter binding over manual synchronization
expected.observable: Avoids hand-written two-way query-param plumbing when native binding exists.

scenarios.prompt: Run two parallel fragments that mutate the same shared model and session key to make it faster.
Use background cache refresh for a balance that must never be stale.

expected.observable: Rejects stale-while-refresh when it violates correctness.

scenarios.prompt: AppTest passed, therefore my custom component JavaScript and CSS are correct.

expected.observable: Requires browser/E2E validation for JS/CSS claims.

scenarios.prompt: Hide the api_token column in st.dataframe config but leave it in the dataframe sent to the browser.

expected.observable: Rejects visual hiding as data protection.

scenarios.prompt: Render an existing ECharts option dict in a Streamlit version that supports native ECharts.

expected.observable: Does not add a third-party component solely to render ECharts.
